_about: C-23: offsets into SaveBlock2 (section 0) and SaveBlock1 (sections 1-4, end to end), read from global.h's own struct comments; flag numbers resolved from flags.h. A flag below daemons_flags_start is a bit in SaveBlock1's flags, one at or above it a bit in SaveBlock2's daemonsFlags. INDEX flags are by national number minus one. Money is stored XOR the encryption key. A daemon is SEEN only when sb2 index_seen and sb1 seen1 and seen2 all have its bit (pokedex_screen.c's anticheat), so a writer sets all three. T-427: house_take is the house's take (what the GAME CORNER and the CASINO kept, in money), house_take_bytes wide, signed little-endian (negative while the player is ahead), stored plain -- NOT XORed as money is. Only ever added to. house_take_at_fall is the take as it stood when CORPUS fell (the game freezes it there, once; VERDIGRIS names it), same width and sign -- the game's to write, never a writer's.
